subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose `models.providers.*.retry` now, or should retry stay on the canonical retry tracker until the full runtime contract is approved?
rationale: The retry shape changes public provider config and fallback timing semantics, and repository policy treats provider routing/config additions as compatibility-sensitive product/API direction.

options.title: Split Retry Out
options.body: Remove retry schema/help/label/type additions here and keep this PR focused on a proven `request.timeoutMs` change.

options.title: Implement Full Retry Contract
options.body: Wire retry into model calls with retryable error classification, fallback ordering, docs/baseline, and focused runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause For Retry Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers settle provider-vs-agent retry scope on the canonical retry issue.

recommendation.title: Split Retry Out
recommendation.body: Remove retry schema/help/label/type additions here and keep this PR focused on a proven `request.timeoutMs` change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest visible owner for deciding whether to accept a new public config surface in core provider routing.
